reviews.text: The best veterinary clinic in Madrid. The care is impeccable, and the clinic's services are the most comprehensive: X-rays, surgery, lab work, grooming, and a shop. My dog ​​Pancho, now 15 years old, is still with us thanks to the excellent professionals who work there. He's had gallbladder surgery, a fatty tumor removal, and has been treated for acute gastroenteritis—all successfully. I will always be grateful to you and your outstanding work.
First time here. The staff was very friendly. We thought Antonio was great. We took our puppy in for a dental issue. Both the diagnosis and the explanation were quite good.

Life is funny like that. Just a few days ago, a friend recommended the clinic for one of my dogs, who ultimately didn't need it. And today, when we woke up and saw that another one of my girls, my Polka, had a swollen face, I messaged them on WhatsApp. In less than ten minutes, Estefania had contacted me, and despite Antonio's commitments, they waited until we crossed Madrid to welcome Polka in the most unexpected way, with the kindness and care that you rarely see in veterinary clinics anymore. And without any waiting, Antonio and Luis had a clear diagnosis and treatment plan, no doubts, no suggestions for expensive and confusing tests… It was a gift to find you. Thank you, thank you, thank you.
They are very friendly and inspire confidence. Excellent professionals.

Impeccable. We took our dog in because she was suffering terribly from a severe dental infection and several broken teeth. They treated her wonderfully and operated that same day, dedicating their free time at midday to avoid delaying the procedure. The operation went very well; the surgeon explained each step to us until our dog woke up and we were able to take her home. They were incredibly patient and caring with her. Subsequent checkups have been a success, as she has recovered very well, is eating normally, and is not in any pain. We have nothing but words of gratitude for their excellent work and professionalism. We have scheduled regular follow-up appointments to prevent her from experiencing a recurrence of her initial condition. We highly recommend their veterinary service and wholeheartedly support them. Thank you so much!

I want to highlight the exceptional human qualities and empathy of the entire team. In good times, everything is perfect, and in difficult times, they offer understanding and time that is rarely found. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Chispa. I highly recommend them for their professionalism and outstanding service.

Antonio's professionalism, confidence, and the peace of mind he inspires are priceless. My puppy is always happy because she knows how well she's treated. Everyone there is truly wonderful, the clinic is fantastic, and the prices are comparable to most, but you pay more knowing you're in the best hands!

Without a doubt, the best clinic in Madrid. They treat my dog ​​Kovu like royalty and are incredibly skilled professionals with many years of experience. I even did an internship there and saw firsthand how well they work, how much they care for the animals, and how clearly they explain everything to clients and to me as a student.

We took our cat Copita to this clinic for some dental problems, and the experience was excellent.

We especially want to highlight Antonio's excellent service from the very first moment, as well as that of the rest of the clinic staff. They explained everything to us about Copita's periodontal disease, and we were able to see and understand the treatment they were going to perform.

In the end, they had to extract four teeth, and everything went very well. We are very happy with the result and the care our cat received.

It's true that it may be a little more expensive than other clinics, but we sincerely believe it's worth it for the professionalism, attention, and care they show to both the animals and their owners. We would definitely trust them again.

Thank you so much!
We went with our cat Copita and it was a real pleasure to meet that great team of professionals. They let you be by your pet's side throughout the entire process. Thank you!

I can only express my gratitude, starting with Estefanía and ending with everyone on this team.

You can see their professionalism and empathy towards the animals and their owners. It's clear they have a genuine desire to do a good job and want everyone to feel comfortable in their facilities.

Without a doubt, this should be your go-to veterinary clinic if you live in this area.

We were very pleased with the care Bimba received and the gentleness they demonstrate in managing their patients.

There are some really good professionals here; you can tell when someone loves their job.
Thanks for everything, Antonio.

Excellent vet, not the cheapest, but definitely very effective, he solves whatever your pet has in no time! The clinic is well-equipped with the latest technology. My dog's surgery went perfectly! Another vet had told my sister that she had to be euthanized, but she took her to this vet and so far the kitten is doing well, thanks Dr. Antonio.
I've known them for many years and for me they are the best
Highly professional and animal lovers. You have to see the affection, concern, and dedication they have for our pets.

After months of searching for a veterinary clinic I could trust to have my dog's teeth cleaned, and thanks to the reviews, I found this wonderful team of professionals who answered all our questions and allowed us to be present during the procedure, without having to leave our pet at the clinic all day. Thank you so much for everything, we would choose you a thousand times over!

Five stars aren't enough! Today I took my cat, Queso, for dental treatment and I couldn't be more grateful. The care was impeccably professional, but what truly made the difference was the meticulous attention to detail; you can tell when someone loves their work.
I felt calm and supported at all times, as they took care of every little detail of his well-being and gave me complete peace of mind. I left delighted and with the peace of mind of knowing that Queso was in the best hands. Thank you, Dr. Antonio and Raúl, for that level of commitment and gentleness; you are a team I can totally trust!
Highly professional, friendly, and efficient. The clinic has a great atmosphere; you feel right at home.

We found Dr. Antonio through our veterinarian for my cat's dental surgery; he needed almost all his teeth removed. He's not only an excellent dentist—everything went perfectly—but above all, it's his professionalism and the way he treats animals and their owners that truly stand out. We will definitely return for any future health issues. Plus, everyone there is lovely.

I came here because of the reviews, and here's my own after confirming that everything positive was true.
In my case, one of my cats had a serious dental problem that another veterinary clinic didn't recognize as such and downplayed.
After complex surgery, my cat is now happier and healthier, and I have complete peace of mind.
Dr. Antonio is an excellent professional in his field. The 40 km trip was well worth it for us. From now on, they'll be our clinic.
Magnificent team and excellence in all aspects

Veterinarian Antonio performed a complex dental procedure on my cat, and it went very well. Subsequent checkups confirmed he was recovering well. The treatment he and the rest of the clinic team provided was exceptional, and I'm very pleased with their concern, involvement, and empathy. As it was a specialized surgical procedure, we were referred from the DRAMP veterinary clinic in Arganda del Rey (which I'm also extremely happy with). I highly recommend both clinics.

After several years of visiting the clinic—initially occasionally, and then, as my dog ​​grew older, much more frequently—I have only words of profound gratitude and sincere congratulations.

From the first day to the last, the experience has been exceptional, not only because of the professionalism and technical expertise applied to each situation, but also, and especially, because of the treatment we always received from all the clinic staff, who, as a final touch, helped me immensely during the painful process of having to put my longtime companion down.

I will return with a new client as soon as possible.
Thank you so much for everything.
Very, very good as always, thank you

I'm quite demanding when it comes to medical services, and when I give this center a five-star rating, it's because it truly deserves it.

Certainly, their prices are a bit higher than average, but the service, the professionalism, the sense of trust they inspire, and something as simple as having someone answer the phone without a 20-minute wait, is something I truly appreciate. My Kora has found her medical home.

I have no words to express my gratitude for the exceptional care my dog ​​Miguel received. He had been suffering from a severe infection for weeks, and after several evaluations at different clinics, they finally arrived at the correct diagnosis here. The cause was cellulitis originating in a tooth, and he had to have surgery.

Throughout the entire process, they allowed us to be with him every step of the way, clearly explaining each procedure and always showing him love and dedication. The follow-up care was equally attentive and professional.

I especially want to highlight the warm and humane treatment I received from Antonio and the receptionist, who treated my pet as what he truly is to me: part of my family.

The best veterinary team in Madrid. By far.

We had four animals: two dogs and two cats. From the first time we took them, more than five years ago, the personalized, caring, and impeccably professional treatment was wonderful. When one of our dogs suddenly collapsed and we took her in, Luis quickly diagnosed a tumor in her spleen, which he operated on flawlessly the next day.
Our other dog, suffering from multiple ailments due to her age, was monitored meticulously by Antonio, who knew exactly what to do at every moment with precision and care.
The tumor in our first dog was very aggressive; we underwent chemotherapy, and she lived happily for the months she was on it thanks to his guidance. Sadly, the fatal decision had to be made, and during that awful time, we couldn't have been better supported by this amazing team. A few months later, our oldest dog couldn't go on any longer, and we also had to go through the same process.

The humanity of this team towards people and animals is immeasurable and undeniable. The love with which we were able to say goodbye (including them) to our loved ones is something I will be eternally grateful for. It's not easy to feel at home in a veterinary clinic, and they managed it.
It's still the place I take my cats; I couldn't feel safer. When Estefanía holds them, they allow handling that I would never guarantee for any other human being (myself included).

And what can I say about Elena? She's the heart and soul of the place. The care she provides to dogs, cats, and humans is truly heartwarming.
Things are expensive when they're overpriced, and this clinic isn't.
THANK YOU TEAM for making the most difficult things easier. ❤️

My dog ​​has died. She had surgery here and just passed away. They should have said that the operation could have gone wrong or something so I could think about what to do. She suffered every week instead of taking the €2000. You don't care about animals, you only care about money. It's a real shame.

I've been with dogs my whole life, and I've been going to this clinic since the beginning. Only with them do I have absolute confidence in their diagnoses. They saved my previous dog's life when she was on the verge of death. I currently live 300 km from Madrid, and I'd rather travel the 600 km round trip than waste my time and risk my dog's health with any other vet. They are accurate in their diagnoses, the operating room is fantastic, and they are incredibly skilled and experienced. They are highly professional, constantly improving both their clinic equipment (they have the latest technology) and their already extensive training. They provide excellent and honest service. They are a 10 out of 10.

Antonio and his team are fantastic professionals. I went to them on their recommendation for periodontal treatment for my dog, and it was the right choice!
Thank you, Antonio and Sara, for your wonderful work and your kind and compassionate care!
They're wonderful. They've helped me a lot with my old furry friend. I'm so grateful!

We are absolutely delighted with this clinic. Everyone treated us wonderfully and they let us stay with Zeus throughout the entire procedure (even providing us with a small room to be with him while he woke up). Antonio explained everything to us with great patience, and it's clear he's a true professional. Elena, from the first time I called and told her that Zeus is a bit of a rascal, made everything easy for us so that Zeus wouldn't have to come into contact with other large dogs. We came on the recommendation of a friend, and what a great decision it was!

Thank you, Dr. Antonio, and the entire team. They performed a dental cleaning and extraction on our dog, and everything was perfect, 10/10. True professionals. They allowed us to be present the whole time, observing the entire procedure while they explained everything to us. We will definitely be back! The best clinic.

We took our little Bambi in for a cleaning and tooth extraction, and the truth is, Antonio's work was spectacular, not to mention the great work of Sara, the other doctor (sorry I forgot his name), and everyone who works at this center. It was our first time and we're very happy... our new trusted clinic, thank you so much 🙏 …

Fantastic! My dog ​​had a periodontal cleaning and it went wonderfully. Antonio is a marvelous professional and I have complete confidence in him. The people who helped me on the phone and at reception were incredibly kind and understanding of my concerns, and I'm very happy. I live in Pozuelo and I'm happy to travel all the way to Mirasierra.
Good veterinarians
My new trusted vet lovingly cured my dog ​​of an ear infection!
Highly professional dentist 👌🏻 Dr. Antonio is very kind and knows what he's doing. 100% recommended. Thank you to the entire team at this clinic 🤍🤍 …

Excellent veterinary clinic! We took our dog in for a broken tooth, and they examined her urgently and with great care. The staff is fantastic; they answer all your questions and treat you with empathy, putting your mind at ease when you're worried about your pet. They gave us an appointment for her surgery right away, and everything went perfectly. I definitely recommend them!

Highly professional. You can trust their judgment and their expertise. They inspire confidence. They and their team are our regular veterinarians and incredibly compassionate. Thank you for everything.
A trustworthy and highly recommended clinic; I have two bulldogs and they love them!
Very professional and excellent service.
Excellent professionals and a very friendly approach

They've deleted my review several times, the one I posted about my experience with my dog ​​a few years ago. And apparently, it's not the only one they've managed to remove. Mafiosos in every sense of the word. That's how they operate, thankfully people are already well aware of them.

Edit: To respond. Of course I'm not a customer, I'm a former customer. It would be absurd for me to remain a customer after the experience my dog ​​and I had with you. I may be many things, but I'm not a masochist. Best regards. Oh, and report me all you want, I'll keep posting as many times as necessary.

We were recommended this clinic by the daycare where we left Lola, and it was an excellent recommendation!
The traumatologist, Luis, explained the benefits and risks of treatment to us …
